evaluations.title: Publicly accessible storage bucket
evaluations.message: The bucket policy allows anonymous read access to evidence artifacts.

remediation.summary: Remove anonymous principals and restrict bucket access to approved workload identities only.

evaluations.title: Sensitive evidence storage lacks access restrictions
evaluations.message: Evidence artifacts can be downloaded publicly instead of through managed authorization checks.

remediation.summary: Move the bucket behind managed access controls and enable public access blocks.
